test_cases.objective:
Verify that archived provenance data is available to science users
together with the associated science data products.

LVV-18232.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Data Management System shall provide tools
to re-run a data processing operation under the same conditions as a
previous run of that operation, based on provenance data recorded by the
system.

test_cases.name: Verify availability of re-run tools
test_cases.objective:
Verify that tools are provided to use the archived provenance data to
re-run a data processing operation under the same conditions (including
LSST software version, its configuration parameters, and supporting data
such as calibration frames) as a previous run of that operation.

LVV-18233.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} A re-run based on provenance, if run on a
different system (but whose configuration still meets established LSST
requirements), shall produce results which are the same to the extent
computationally feasible (with the exception of provenance data or other
execution records that depend on the wall-clock time or on variable
system loads).

test_cases.name: Verify re-run on different system produces the same results
test_cases.objective:
Verify that tools are provided to use the archived provenance data to
re-run a data processing operation on different systems, and that the
results produced are the same to the extent computationally feasible.~

LVV-18234.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} A re-run based on provenance, if run on the same
system or a system with identically configured hardware and system
software, shall produce the same results (with the exception of
provenance data or other execution records that depend on the wall-clock
time or on variable system loads).

test_cases.name: Verify re-run on similar system produces the same results
test_cases.objective:
Verify that a provenance-based re-run that is run on the same system, or
a system with identically configured hardware and system software,
produces the same results.~

LVV-18271.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0001-V-01: Fulfill requirements of a Commandable SAL Component (CSC)_1

LVV-18272.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service instances shall be considered
a critical system for observatory operations and shall reside within the
EFD computer cluster.

LVV-18273.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0003-V-01: Write Headers for all images taken by all Cameras supported by LSST_1
LVV-18273.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service instances shall write header
files for all (100\%) of the images taken and announced by the Camera
Control System for the camera for which each instance is configured
(LSSTCam, ComCam, AuxTel or Test Stand) while the instance is enabled,
including information for every CCD configured for that camera in its
observing mode such as science and wavefront CCDs for LSSTCam.

LVV-18274.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0004-V-01: Ability to capture metadata at the beginning of exposure_1
LVV-18274.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall be able to capture and
store Events or Telemetry before the start of an integration.

LVV-18275.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0005-V-01: Ability to capture metadata during of exposure integration_1
LVV-18275.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall be able to capture and
store Events or Telemetry that happen during the image integration time.

LVV-18276.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0006-V-01: Ability to capture metadata at end of readout_1
LVV-18276.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall be able to capture and
store Events or Telemetry that happen at or slightly after the end of
readout, up to the receipt of the end-of-telemetry event.

LVV-18277.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0007-V-01: Write header and Publish Event after end of telemetry event_1
LVV-18277.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall begin to write the
header file(s) immediately after receiving the end-of-telemetry Event
from the Camera Control System and, when complete, emit one or more
LargeFileObjectAvailable Events that will notify the EFD of the
existence of the new header file(s).

LVV-18278.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0008-V-01: Write header and Publish Event within specified time of the end-of-telemetry Event_1
LVV-18278.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall complete the writing of
the header file and emit the LFO Event within 200 milliseconds.

LVV-18279.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0009-V-01: Adherence to the FITS Standard_1
LVV-18279.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The contents of the file(s) written by the
Header Service will be consistent with the data needed to generate
compliant FITS headers.

LVV-18280.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0010-V-01: Configuration of Header Keywords and source_1
LVV-18280.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall be configurable as to
the keywords used to identify metadata that goes into the header as well
as configurable as to the source of that metadata. The sources may be
Events or Telemetry to which the Header Service will subscribe or
elements of the Header Service\textquotesingle s own configuration.

LVV-18281.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0011-V-01: Produce header even if some meta-data not avaiable_1
LVV-18281.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall write headers even with
faulty or missing Telemetry.

LVV-18282.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0012-V-01: Publish an Event if monitoring detects any failure of the service._1
LVV-18282.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall publish an Event
message describing the type of problem if it detects that its service is
degraded in some way.

LVV-18283.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0013-V-01: Extract metadata from published configuration_1
LVV-18283.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall be able to extract
metadata from the configuration information published by other CSCs such
as the Camera Control System and the Telescope Control System.

LVV-18284.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall capture at a minimum
all metadata required by Prompt Processing, Archiving, and any relevant
Summit systems.

LVV-18285.summary: OCS-EFD-HS-0015-V-01: Generate on-the-fly additional metadata requested by the Project Science Team._1
LVV-18285.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Header Service shall be able to do
light-weight computations to generate additional metadata as requested
by the project in case it is not directly provided by other CSCs.

LVV-18295.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The LSST Data Management subsystem shall produce
a searchable - interactive nightly report(s), from information published
in the EFD by each subsystem, summarizing performance and behavior over
a user defined period of time (e.g. the previous 24 hours).

test_cases.name: Verify Implementation of Data Management Nightly Reporting
test_cases.objective:
Verify that the LSST Data Management subsystem produces a searchable -
interactive nightly report(s), from information published in the EFD by
each subsystem, summarizing performance and behavior over a user defined
period of time (e.g. the previous 24 hours).

LVV-18297.description:
This VE satisfies the requirement on numStreams=5. The related VE
\href{https://jira.lsstcorp.org/browse/LVV-18911}{LV-18911} pertains to
the latency (OTT1).
LVV-18297.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} LSST shall be capable of supporting the
transmission of at least \textbf{numStreams} full alert streams out of
the alert distribution system within \textbf{OTT1}.

test_cases.name: Verify implementation of at least numStreams alert streams supported
test_cases.objective:
Verify that the LSST system supports the transmission of at least
\textbf{numStreams=5} full alert streams out of the alert distribution
system within \textbf{OTT1=1 minute}.~

LVV-18298.description:
This verification element corresponds to the fraction of alerts
distributed, OTR1 = 98{{[}percent{]}}.

Related requirements are addressed in the sibling verification elements.
LVV-18298.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The system shall reliably produce alerts for
standard science visits read out in the camera {{[}and specified to be
analyzed by Data Management{]}} such that no more than
\textbf{sciVisitAlertDelay} per cent of visits will fail to have at
least \textbf{OTR1} per cent of its alerts distributed via the LSST
alert distribution system within \textbf{OTT1}, and no more than
\textbf{sciVisitAlertFailure} per cent of visits will fail to generate
and distribute alerts (integrated over all stages of data handling)

test_cases.name: Verify Fraction of Alerts Transmitted Within Latency Threshold
test_cases.objective:
Verify that at least \textbf{OTR1 = 98{[}percent{]}} of detectable
alerts are actually transmitted within latency \textbf{OTT1 =
1{[}minute{]}}.~

LVV-18299.summary: DMS-REQ-0393-V-01: Average Number of Alerts Per Visit
LVV-18299.description:
This verification element corresponds to the average number of alerts
per standard visit, \textbf{nAlertVisitAvg} \textbf{=
10000{{[}integer{]}}}.

The related sibling verification element satisfies the additional
constraint on the peak number of alerts per visit,
\textbf{nAlertVisitPeak = 40000{{[}integer{]}}}.
LVV-18299.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The system shall be able to identify and
distribute an average of at least \textbf{nAlertVisitAvg} alerts per
standard visit during a given night, and at least
\textbf{nAlertVisitPeak} for a single standard visit.

\textbf{Specification:} Performance shall degrade gracefully beyond
\textbf{nAlertVisitAvg}.

test_cases.name: Verify Handling of Average Number of Alerts
test_cases.objective:
Verify that the system can identify and distribute an average
of~\textbf{nAlertVisitAvg~= 10000{[}integer{]}~}alerts per standard
visit over a given night.

requirements.summary: DMS-REQ-0393-V-01: Average Number of Alerts Per Visit

LVV-18339.description:

LVV-18339.req_spec:

calculation of the photometric performance metrics defined in

test_cases.name:

applied.

outlier limit threshold (PA4) to computed values of metrics.~

requirements.summary: DMS-REQ-0359-V-18: Outlier limit on zero points

LVV-18465.req_spec:

LVV-18491.description:
Verify (a) plannned and (b) as-built VOIP at the Base Facility is
operational and performs as expected (i.e. sufficient number of
extensions allocated properly, no frequent drop-outs, no frequent
jaggies on video, etc.). Test voice calls and videoconferening.
LVV-18491.req_spec:
\textbf{Specification:} The Base LAN shall provide \textbf{minBaseWiFi}
Wireless LAN (WiFi) and Wireless Access Points in the Base Facility to
support connectivity of individual user\textquotesingle s computers to
the network backbones.

test_cases.name: Verify Base Voice Over IP (VOIP)
test_cases.precondition:
\begin{enumerate}
\tightlist
\item
  Base VOIP is installed/configured and Test Personnel have phone sets.
  ~Base Videoconference system is installed/configured. ~Summit,
  Headquarters, and/or LDF Videconference system is
  installed/configured.
\item
  As-built documentation for all of the above is available.
\end{enumerate}

expected (i.e. sufficient number of extensions allocated properly, no
frequent drop-outs, no frequent jaggies on video, etc.) on both voice
calls and videoconferening.

distributed, sciVisitAlertFailure = 0.1{{[}percent{]}}.

specified DataIds and Butler dataset types).

least the following execution environments:

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item

\item
  Level 1 near-real-time production.
\item
  Interactive, command-line execution.
\item
  Execution in a persistent server (e.g., to support the SUIT Portal).
\item
  Automated CI and verification testing.
\item

LVV-20546.summary: DMS-PRTL-REQ-0098-V-02: Overlay Catalog of Sources and Objects on Images_2
LVV-20546.description:
This verification element is related to {
\href{https://rubinobs.atlassian.net/browse/LVV-9942}{\hfill\break
\includegraphics[width=1.5625in,,keepaspectratio]{jira_imgs/10318}
LVV-9942} {In Verification} } .

This verification element covers overlays based on what the requirement
calls "observatory-based" coordinates, essentially pixel coordinates,
but with the caveat that as a UI workflow, this should avoid performing
overlays that don\textquotesingle t match the gross location of the
image - e.g., putting them on the wrong detector, or the wrong coadd
tract.

Note that this is only possible in cases where the Portal has access to
pixel coordinates.
LVV-20546.req_spec:
The Portal aspect shall be able to overlay the positions of catalog
sources and objects on a displayed image based upon
astrophysically-based or observatory-based coordinates.

LVV-20867.description:
